seal.statement: The PostgreSQL compatibility certification matrix (src/query/pg/postgres-compatibility-matrix.js, docs/postgres-compatibility-matrix.json, test/query/q10-postgres-compatibility-certification-matrix.test.js) certifies the product's SQL surface, not the generating host's client build. The exact client builds (driver versions) are environment metadata recorded beside the matrix, outside its digest, its cell receipt digests and the content comparison; the content the live run generates must still equal the committed matrix exactly (every cell's status, outcome, SQLSTATE and mutation flag, every negative control, the summary and the digest). The matrix declares the client majors it certifies and refuses, with a typed DRIVER_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED, a host whose client build is outside them. A host with psql 16.15 (hosted runner) and one with psql 14.24 (this controller) then certify the same committed matrix.

text: Measured host dependence. Hosted CI run 41431327759 (ordinary proof, 2026-11-02): test/query/q10-postgres-compatibility-certification-matrix.test.js not ok at the deep-equal against docs/postgres-compatibility-matrix.json (test.js:1254) on first pass and on its standalone retry; the hosted runner's psql is 16.15 while the committed matrix pinned driverVersions.psql 14.24 (this controller's psql 14.24, Ubuntu 22.04) and both the matrix digest and every psql cell's driverVersion and receiptDigest covered it (evidence/hosted-run-41431327759-q10-excerpt.log.txt). Parsing the run's printed actual matrix: all 71 cells (status, observedOutcome, sqlState, mutationPrevented) and all 9 negative-control digests equal the committed matrix; only the driver-version fields differ. The 'multiple statements in one query are not supported' and 'OFFSET without LIMIT is unsupported' lines in that log are the expected negative-control refusals (0A000/XX000), not the failure. The lab cone of 2026-11-02 on adams-gamla failed the same file the same way (reported by the lead; not re-measured here, its psql build not recorded in this quest). Decision: option (a) - the driver versions are environment beside the matrix, outside its digest and cell receipt digests, and the matrix declares its certified client majors (psql 14 and 16 admitted by the measurement above; node-pg 8 and pg-pool 3 locked), refusing any other with DRIVER_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED.

Option (a). src/query/pg/postgres-compatibility-catalog.js: schema lagrange-postgres-compatibility-matrix/2, PG_COMPAT_SUPPORTED_CLIENT_MAJORS (psql 14 and 16 by measurement, node-pg 8, pg-pool 3) and error code DRIVER_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED. src/query/pg/postgres-compatibility-matrix.js: the cell receipt digest and the matrix cells no longer carry the driver version; the matrix digest covers supportedClientMajors instead of driverVersions; validateDriverVersions refuses a build outside the declared majors (assertSupportedClientBuild, typed, naming client, version and majors); the generated matrix records environment.driverVersions beside the content, outside the digest; verifyCompatibilityMatrixRegression reads the driver versions from environment and no longer compares them per cell. docs/postgres-compatibility-matrix.json regenerated through generatePostgresCompatibilityMatrix from its own recorded observations (environment psql 14.24, this controller), confirmed equal to the live run. Test: the committed comparison is on the certified content (all fields but environment) plus the digest; new tests for a psql 16.15 host certifying the same content and digest, and for psql 9.6, node-pg 7.18.2 and an unparsable psql build refused. scripts/checks/q10-postgres-compatibility-certification-matrix-guard.js token follows the schema. Red first (2 tests red), green 10/10, three mutations red; lane 1 file pass=1; test:static 33/33. CHANGELOG entry. Paths: the two src modules, the matrix JSON, the q10 test, the guard, CHANGELOG.md, quest records.

Independent fresh-context verification at 88e49ceb2e287c2e130041e8ec944c7c2fc76c70 (base 6d58fdba16157740e6c2f0bae5a2317fa24e0944 = seal; 17 files; fingerprint cec0cc50af4490668f67029596ea86476e84550c38b59762acbc71f0de616165): APPROVE. Certified content unchanged from schema /1 to /2: 71 cells with zero content differences once driverVersion and receiptDigest are excluded, 9 negative controls byte-identical, summary identical; the digest input set swaps driverVersions for supportedClientMajors and cells drop driverVersion, nothing else left the digest. The psql 16 admission is a real measurement verified independently of the author's parse: the hosted log of run 41431327759 (head df28ef54a, byte-identical matrix module, catalog, q10 test and /1 artifact to the sealed base; ubuntu-24.04, postgresql-client 16+257 = psql 16.15, node-pg 8.18.0, pg-pool 3.11.0) prints expected matrixDigest 1c542bde... and actual 68b97d8bfadfb05fa294af5867a4790fdfe07da48a5b4e780dae53b3370608d1; feeding the controller's own /1 observations relabelled psql 16.15 through the base-commit module reproduces 68b97d8b... exactly (unrelabelled reproduces 1c542bde...), a complete content-identity witness because the old digest covers every cell field and all controls. Regenerated artifact (R05): a live q10 run with a dump hook produced JSON byte-identical to the committed docs/postgres-compatibility-matrix.json (sha256 1475e13d...), the candidate module fed the /1 observations reproduces the committed /2 bytes, and with psql 16.15 the same digest and content minus environment. Typed refusal: one path (validateDriverVersions in generate and verify); an unsupported host fails the suite loudly as hookFailed DRIVER_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED with no skip; psql 9.6, 16 without minor, unknown, 17beta1, node-pg 7.18.2, pg-pool 4.0.0 all refused with clientId, version, supportedMajors. supportedClientMajors is inside the digest, so widening it (mutant [14,16,17]) turns the committed comparison red. Mutations: range check removed -> test 4 red; driverVersion in receipt digest -> 2 red; digest drops supportedClientMajors -> 2 red; versions back in digest fn and payload -> 2 red; host psql 9.6 -> typed hook failure. Guard token /2 exercised both ways. Lane: q10 file ok 11 assertions; test:static 33/33; metadata refresh leaves the worktree clean.
